{{Current events|year=2019|month=06|day=22|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Amhara Region coup d'état attempt]]
**An attempted coup in [[Ethiopia]]'s [[Amhara Region|Amhara state]] leaves several people dead, including the regional president [[Ambachew Mekonnen]] and the  Chief of Staff of the [[Ethiopian National Defense Force]], General [[Se'are Mekonnen]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48734572 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A seven-story building collapses in [[Sihanoukville (city)|Sihanoukville]], [[Cambodia]], killing at least 28 people and wounding 25 others. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jun/24/chinese-builders-arrested-as-toll-in-cambodia-building-collapse-rises-to-24 (The Guardian)]

;International relations
*[[Iran–Saudi Arabia relations]] 
**Saudi Arabia's Minister of State for Foreign Affairs [[Adel Al-Jubeir]] says if Iran closes the [[Strait of Hormuz]], there will be a "very, very strong reaction". [http://www.arabnews.com/node/1514276/saudi-arabia (Arab News)]
*[[United States sanctions against Iran]], [[Iran–United States relations]], [[Iran and weapons of mass destruction]]
**The [[United States]] announces "major" sanctions against [[Iran]] to prevent them from obtaining nuclear weapons. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48732672 (BBC)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/vows-major-sanctions-iran-190622195442933.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Mauritanian presidential election]]
**Voters in [[Mauritania]] head to the polls to elect a new president. The election would be the country's first democratic transition of power, as incumbent president [[Mohammed Ould Abdel Aziz]] prepares to step down after having served two terms. [https://www.dw.com/en/west-african-nation-islamic-republic-of-mauritania-heads-to-the-polls/a-49305828 (DW)]
*British Foreign Office Minister [[Mark Field]] is suspended for assaulting a [[Greenpeace]] activist. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-48718725 (BBC)]
*The [[Presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] releases a $50 billion plan that calls for investment in [[Economy of the State of Palestine|Palestine's economy]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/ncna1020666 (NBC News)]
